newsitem.title: UK: EBRD to lend Russia $28.5 mln to help investment.
newsitem.headline: EBRD to lend Russia $28.5 mln to help investment.

text.p: The European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (EBRD) said on Tuesday that it had agreed to lend Russia $28.5 million to promote foreign investment and help develop capital markets.
The loan will assist Russian enterprises in restructuring and promote better corporate governance standards in state-owned companies, the EBRD said in a news release.

"All these issues are critical to the reform process, and it is important for the EBRD to be able to work with the Russian government on these critical issues," it quoted EBRD President Jacques de Larosiere as saying.
The latest credit, referred to as a post-privatisation support loan, was agreed at the EBRD's annual meeting in London. It carries a six-year maturity and two-year grace period.

An initial loan was approved by the EBRD in 1993 to assist the Russian government with its mass privatisation programme, but it was not fully utilised because this effort was widely supported with bilateral grants.
